tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: Hero stage only. Matched to the portrait's backdrop so the photo dissolves into it; eases into pine below the fold.

tokens.name: pine
tokens.usage: The field. Page background for every section after the hero.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Sage paper. One band per page (Investments) and the whole /profile/ document.

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: Headings, the name, numbers and ledger roles on pine and night.

tokens.name: sage-body
tokens.usage: Body and deck text on pine. 8.0:1.

tokens.name: sage-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, years, labels on pine. 5.4:1; never dimmer.

tokens.name: sage-rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines on pine: ledger rows, number rules, footer.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and the names wall on paper.

tokens.name: ink-body
tokens.usage: Body text on paper. 7.2:1.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Captions and labels on paper. 5.0:1; never dimmer.

tokens.name: ink-rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines on paper.

tokens.name: brass
tokens.usage: The one accent, on pine and night only (6.9:1): the wordmark dot, the kicker, hover arrows, the contact underline. Never a fill, never on paper.

tokens.name: brass-ink
tokens.usage: Brass on paper (4.8:1): exit marks on the names wall, link underlines, the profile kicker.

tokens.name: brass-glow
tokens.usage: Soft glow around the wordmark dot. Nowhere else.

styles.usage: Header mark, always with the brass dot.
